title: A skewed tenant workload versus its average
method: Synthetic ten-tenant workload: nine tenants ×50 requests/second plus one ×550 =1,000. Mean per tenant is 100; largest tenant is 55% of traffic and 5.5× the mean. These are logical tenant loads, not database partition limits or benchmark results.
alt: A skewed tenant workload versus its average. Balanced average: 100 requests per second; Small tenant: 50 requests per second; Largest tenant: 550 requests per second. Illustrative values.
